story.title: The Mistral Cipher
story.subtitle: An aviator’s memorial dinner hides the route of a missing reconnaissance flight.
story.premise: test pilot Émile Vauban's memorial dinner for the tenth anniversary of the vanished Mistral flight brings five accomplished strangers to a house in Grambois. Each accepted a different private promise from Émile Vauban; one came to make sure that promise could never be kept.

characters.name: Thérèse Vidal
characters.title: Aviation columnist
characters.costume: 1960s Riviera evening wear suited to aviation columnist
characters.publicFace: Brisk, glamorous, and delighted by contradiction
characters.invitationPretext: You were invited to test pilot Émile Vauban's memorial dinner for the tenth anniversary of the vanished Mistral flight in your public capacity as aviation columnist.
characters.invitationPromise: Émile promised you the uncensored Mistral flight log.
characters.privateIdentity: You helped publish the false crash story under government pressure.
characters.privateObjective: Correct the record without destroying your career.
characters.privateSecret: You removed the fuel page years ago and brought it back tonight.

objectives.title: Gain useful leverage

objectives.title: Shape the reckoning

relationships.text: André Masson can confirm part of your cover story, but only by exposing their own.

solutionSteps.title: The flight that landed
solutionSteps.truth: The Mistral aircraft did not crash; it landed secretly and delivered reconnaissance film to a foreign buyer.

solutionSteps.title: The survivor’s last correction
solutionSteps.truth: René Cassin killed Émile because Émile planned to reveal René as the buyer’s courier.

openingSteps.title: Receive Thérèse Vidal
openingSteps.instruction: Invite Thérèse Vidal to deliver only the prepared opening fact. Thérèse Vidal: Read the official crash time, then reveal that the fuel figures make it impossible.

openingSteps.title: Receive André Masson
openingSteps.trigger: After Thérèse Vidal completes their cue
openingSteps.instruction: Invite André Masson to deliver only the prepared opening fact. André Masson: State that the Mistral left in perfect condition and accuse the official inquiry of lying.

openingSteps.title: Receive Isabelle Dumas
openingSteps.trigger: After André Masson completes their cue
openingSteps.instruction: Invite Isabelle Dumas to deliver only the prepared opening fact. Isabelle Dumas: Correct the memorial date and say your father was alive three days after the supposed crash.

openingSteps.title: Receive Miles Graham
openingSteps.trigger: After Isabelle Dumas completes their cue
openingSteps.instruction: Invite Miles Graham to deliver only the prepared opening fact. Miles Graham: Call the flight an unfortunate reconnaissance accident and ask everyone to honour official history.

openingSteps.title: Discover the host
openingSteps.trigger: After Miles Graham completes their cue
openingSteps.instruction: Cue René Cassin, stage Émile Vauban's off-page collapse without contact, announce the discovery, and become Game Master. René Cassin: Propose a toast to Émile as the only survivor and insist the crash story must remain untouched.

host.name: Émile Vauban
host.title: Émile Vauban, celebrated test pilot and sole public survivor; then Game Master

story.solutionSummary: René brokered the secret landing and built his career on the myth of the crash. Émile convened the memorial to correct the record. René killed him during the commemorative toast and tried to make the dispute look like rivalry between pilot and mechanic. Five private accounts reconstruct the landing and René’s foreknowledge.

clues.text: The logged fuel use is consistent with a landing, not a crash at sea.
René possessed a weather code available only to the foreign buyer’s courier.
Émile invited each guest because each held one segment of the hidden flight path.
A cottage map marks an improvised landing strip rather than wreckage.
René described the film canister before its existence was made public.

acts.title: The fatal interruption
acts.operatorGoal: Establish test pilot Émile Vauban's memorial dinner for the tenth anniversary of the vanished Mistral flight, stage the single no-contact death, then become Game Master.
acts.playerGoal: Deliver only your short prepared cue and wait for the body to be discovered before bargaining begins.
